briefTitle: Study of CP-383 in Patients With Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable or non measurable cancer that the research can assess for changes
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease assessment is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Not eligible or able to take existing standard therapies for cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Eligibility for standard therapies is a clinical judgment, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Availability of a part of a tumor for laboratory testing or willing to have a safe biopsy taken from a tumor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to undergo a biopsy procedure is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Diagnosed with locally advanced, recurrent or metastatic incurable disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced, recurrent or metastatic disease without a numbered stage list cannot be mapped to stage_in.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 1: any solid tumor (with the exception of brain cancer) that has progressed, standard therapy is no longer or has not helped the cancer, or is too toxic and for whom a clinical trial is an option for continued treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Broad solid tumor inclusion across multiple parts with specific gene mutations is complex and not a clean typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate blood and urine lab tests
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General lab adequacy is not a specific numeric cutoff check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Inability to swallow pills
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Ability to swallow pills is a clinical assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known history of HIV, HCV, HBV unless cured, controlled with undetectable viral load
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Conditions with exceptions for controlled or cured status are not simple typed exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Clinically significant liver disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Clinically significant disease is an investigator judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Significant gastrointestinal diseases
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Significant disease is an investigator judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of other cancer within past 5 years with certain exceptions for cancers that are likely cured
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior cancer history with cure exceptions cannot be represented as a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Significant cardiac disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Significant cardiac disease is an investigator judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Other diseases that are not well controlled that could make taking the drug unsafe
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Unspecified well-controlled diseases are subject to investigator discretion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Exposure to certain anti-cancer or other drugs within a certain period before the start of study drug
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window with unspecified drugs and periods cannot be expressed as a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Diagnosed with locally advanced, recurrent or metastatic incurable disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is in scope, but the criteria refer broadly to advanced or metastatic solid tumors without a numbered stage list.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to undergo a biopsy is a subjective procedure requirement.
